file: # Target labels: four 32x16 sprites, each with an icon in columns 0-11.
# screen order is One, Self, Many, All; the tengeki copies are byte-identical.
# Many occupies all 20 columns, so its shadow is omitted in both copies.
# Waiting banner: three 32x32 tiles read 待 / 機 / 中. All nonzero indices are lettering.
# Skill type tags: 32x16 sprites, icon in columns 0-11, 20 px left for the word (Attack 26, Weaken 30, Boost 22 px
# do not fit): flagged short forms Atk / Heal / Buff / Weak (glossary §Graphics UI labels). screen/skill_type is the
# four stacked: attack, statusup, statusdown, heal.
# 星 Vandel rank mark: an 8x8 kanji in a 16x8 sprite (the right tile is a bar); drawn as a star symbol.
